tasks.title: Build PersonaHeader — tag/subtitle render or neutral error badge + aria-live
tasks.notes: apps/web/src/components/PersonaHeader.tsx: props `{ persona: Persona }` (never undefined — PersonaDashboardShell only mounts this once loading has passed, T-10). tasks.title: Build ProgramContext — icon/name/type-chip/description render, style composed internally
tasks.notes: apps/web/src/components/ProgramContext.tsx: props `{ program: ProgramContextData }`. Renders program.icon/name/description verbatim and the type chip text = program.type; avatarStyle/typeChip CSS come only from getProgramStyle(program.type) (T-06) — the component destructures exactly {icon, name, type, description} off the prop, so an extraneous field (e.g. an injected avatarStyle) on the prop object is never read. TSDoc documents the FR-4 CSS-composition rule (C-3/C-5) and that this component owns no loading/empty state.

tasks.title: Build PersonaDashboardShell — brand bar + inline identity block + loading/error gating + composition
tasks.notes: apps/web/src/components/PersonaDashboardShell.tsx: props `{ signedInUser?: SignedInUser; persona?: Persona; program: ProgramContextData }` (D-01/D-03, docs/requirements/api.md#persona-shell). `isLoading = persona === undefined`. Always renders the brand-bar left half (logo tile + 'AgentRise Harness'/'AI SDLC Governance'). When !isLoading: renders the identity block inline — signedInUser defined -> name/jobTitle text + deriveInitials(signedInUser.name) (T-05) inside a 34x34px circle colored via formatPersonaTag(persona).color (guarded: only reached when persona is one of the 4 valid, since PersonaHeader/formatPersonaTag already validated it); signedInUser undefined -> the neutral gray circle fallback (D-05, no initials, aria-hidden, no name/jobTitle text). Also when !isLoading, renders `<PersonaHeader persona={persona} />` (T-07) and `<ProgramContext program={program} />` (T-08) inside the header region — both render regardless of whether persona turns out valid or invalid; PersonaHeader owns its own error-badge branch (T-07), ProgramContext is unconditional once past the outer loading gate (C-3). No persona-conditional branching beyond isLoading exists in this file (C-7). TSDoc: prop contract, FR-1's pending-AUTH-01-amendment caveat, FR-5's suppression semantics, and NFR-2's flash-prevention rationale (persona-gated content never renders before persona resolves).

tasks.title: Integration test: loading suppression, cio/raise error badge, identity-bar neutral fallback
tasks.notes: Covers SHP-01-TC-02, via @testing-library/react (already installed). tasks.title: Performance test: PersonaDashboardShell render p95 < 200ms
tasks.notes: Covers SHP-01-TC-04 (SHP-01-NFR-1). Runs inside the existing vitest runner (no new tool, no bench-mode config change — the file matches vitest.config.ts's existing `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` include glob). Mounts PersonaDashboardShell via @testing-library/react's render() with fully-resolved signedInUser/persona/program props, wraps each of 30 iterations in performance.now(), computes p95, asserts < 200ms. Each iteration unmounts/remounts (testing-library's cleanup) to avoid cross-iteration DOM buildup skewing later renders.
